item.title: Past Simple 'to be': Was / Were questions
item.subject: english
item.topic: Past Simple 'to be': Was / Were questions
item.description: כדי לשאול שאלה עם העבר של be, מעבירים את was/were להתחלה: Was / Were + נושא? Were you at home? · Was she happy? תשובה קצרה: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't. בשאלות Wh-: Where were you?
